sources.title: Mosa — modular and manufacturing dimensions
sources.scope: Example 600 mm module uses 597 mm manufacturing size; verify actual calibre and joint before combining products.

sources.title: Mosa — general installation advice, 2018-08
sources.scope: Directional surface texture and cutting process affect layout and cut-piece compatibility; this older advice is not a current product approval.

sources.title: Rockfon System T24 A Impact 2A/3A, 02/2024
sources.scope: Specific system has 24 mm wide, 38 mm high members; 3600 mm main runners and 1200/600 mm cross tees. Impact performance is not transferred to generic recipes.

sources.title: Gyproc processing handbook, April 2024
sources.scope: 600 mm centres are a stated baseline for specified metal-stud systems, not a universal rule for HSB or all boards.

sources.title: Knauf Netherlands — gypsum board product range
sources.scope: The range includes 600/1200 mm boards and 12.5 mm A-board; actual product dimensions and application instructions govern.

sources.title: Wienerberger — glazed bricks processing advice
sources.scope: This range lists approximate waal dimensions 210×100×50 mm and an indicative 10 mm bed/head joint consumption example. Dimensions vary by product.

sources.title: NBVT KVT Online — water sealing at frame junctions
sources.scope: Separate head/sill/jamb water-management details are required; a frame rectangle is insufficient. No blanket compliance claim.

sources.title: VBI product sheet PDB05.014 — hollow-core slab 320
sources.scope: This product has 1200 mm plank width and product-specific infill widths; arbitrary tile-like cuts are inappropriate. No span/load/fire values imported.

sources.title: EGGER — OSB 3 JAS TOP brochure
sources.scope: This product document calls for panel-edge expansion gaps. It is evidence for an explicit gap rule, not a Dutch wall approval or universal OSB joint.

sources.title: RHEINZINK Netherlands — standing-seam roofs
sources.scope: Working/developed widths, seam/slope compatibility and expansion clips are product-specific. No dimensions or performance are applied to generic recipes.

sources.title: Rockpanel Netherlands — installation guide
sources.scope: Ventilated cladding needs deliberate cavity, ventilation and fixing details; not a general approval for other cladding materials.

sources.title: Wienerberger — measuring roof tile working dimensions
sources.scope: Covering width and batten gauge depend on actual supplied tiles and accessories; nominal physical size is not the layout pitch.

sources.title: Sto Netherlands — products and systems
sources.scope: Source identifies complete external insulation and ventilated facade system families. It does not validate a generic mixture of system components.
